sub_products.other_flags: rfp_send: alias-based RfP pilot (Apr 2025) for billers; api_access: Yes; api_demo: RTP API Payment Demo: from the client's finance platform select an invoice > 'select real time payment and initiate a transaction' > encrypted request to Truist > encrypted confirmation displayed; RTP API Balance Demo: 'Update Balances'; positioning: 'RTP provides instant confirmations that payments have been sent, received, and fully settled'

capability_detail.email-sms-notifications: true — Digital Treasury alert types 'Incoming Real Time Payment Transaction', 'Real Time Payments Message', 'Payment Request Received' (email/other contact methods, Tools > Contact Center > Notifications > Alerts)

sub_products.name: Disbursements with Zelle (commercial)
sub_products.description: Pay individuals/small businesses by email or mobile number; funds within minutes.
sub_products.other_flags: channel: file-based via MFT mailbox (CSV or pipe-delimited; Excel templates with/without control totals) — not an interactive One View screen; token_validation: pre-payment Token Validation file → Zelle returns Active Token file (with registered owner name) and Inactive Token file within 1–2 minutes; control_totals: payment file first, control-total file within 3 hours (or payment file within 5 minutes if control file first); memo: payment memo up to 200 characters; Customer Reference optional; default or alternate debit account; duplicate_controls: duplicate file (same name/amount within 10 days) rejected; duplicate payment (same token, amount, memo) in a file rejected; required_inputs: recipient's enrolled token (mobile/email), name, sending account, amount

capability_detail.status-tracking: true — 'File Transmission Summary Report' by secure email once all payments reach a final status; final statuses 'Delivered, Sent, Failed or Denied'

sub_products.name: Integrated Payables (outsourced multi-rail disbursement)
sub_products.description: File-based AP outsourcing: virtual card, ACH, wire, check printing (extended next-day check deadline), supplier enablement, reconciliation; token login to One View to approve control totals/payments.
sub_products.other_flags: control_totals_approval: Yes; virtual_card: Yes

sub_products.name: One View Connect (embedded ERP banking, pilot)
sub_products.description: ERP-embedded banking built with Koxa for NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. The public user guide (Rev. 04/26) documents information reporting: real-time balances, posted transactions, on-demand refresh and reconciliation in each ERP's native module. In-ERP Real-Time Payments and approvals were announced for the Oct 2025 pilot (IR release) but are not described in the public guide.
sub_products.other_flags: status: Oct 2025 pilot press release; by Nov 2026 listed as a standard 'Platform' on the Treasury Resource Center with a public 'Truist One View Connect User Guide' — indicates availability beyond pilot (INFERRED from listing; user guide not read); positioning_copy: 'connectivity bridge between Truist and leading ERP and treasury platforms, enabling secure, real-time exchange of banking data and payment activity ... foundation for automation and next-generation, agentic treasury workflows'
sub_products.notes: Rail RTP reflects the Oct 2025 pilot announcement ('Real-Time Payments and approvals, directly within ERP platforms'); current public documentation covers information reporting only.

sub_products.name: Receivables: Integrated Receivables, Lockbox, Remote Deposit Capture, EBPP, Image Cash Letter, Cash Vault, Cash Concentration
sub_products.description: AI-powered matching of check/electronic receipts (Integrated Receivables, AI-enabled launch Feb 2026 per PYMNTS); 4 lockbox types; RDC to 9pm ET; EBPP multichannel bill presentment/payment.
